home.heroSubtitle: A firm of excellence dedicated to international companies
home.home1: WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies since 1974.<nl/>Our firm is dedicated to assisting international companies,  small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defense of our clients before the courts and arbitral tribunals.<nl/>We think further, We work Smarter & We act Swiftly. <nl/> We represent & advise clients on a domestic and international level from corporate and commercial transactions including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, technology transfers, litigation & arbitration, White collar crime, employment and labor law, to corporate governance & law. Our team of about twenty people, focuses exclusively on your business needs to bring you excellent services & solutions in a more efficient & sustainable way.
home.home2: Our firm is a member of an international network of law firms sharing its culture of excellence and efficiency. Our lawyers are also admitted to practice before foreign bars, including Germany or the New York Bar in the United States. <nl/>In addition to French and English, the team also works in German, making the firm a high-level partner with expertise in cross-border business relations between France and Germany.

expertise.ourGoal: <bold>Our goal is very simple:</bold> To provide successful businesses, individuals and entrepreneurs with high-level tailored services to solve their problems. The law is constantly evolving, along with related developments in your industry and the larger economy, may affect you and your business. That’s why we are making a point to always go further work smarter and always act swiftly with your best interest in mind and greatest attention to detail.

droitSocialrestructuration.title: Labor law and restructuring
droitSocialrestructuration.intro: <blue>Weil</blue> has been supporting its clients since 1974 in the context of various social law issues, in advice and litigation.
droitSocialrestructuration.paragraph1: We assist HR managers of multinational groups in complex and sensitive cross-border restructuring operations, in particular workforce reductions, site closures or company transfers.We intervene also in areas such as the integration of codes of good conduct and internal regulations, the negotiation of collective agreements on participation, profit-sharing or flexible working time, discrimination, termination of employment contracts and individual disputes or Our Firm Finally, for more than twenty years, has been advising the employer side in the context of the annual negotiation of a sectoral collective agreement.For any questions relating to subjects of interest in the field of labor law, you can contact our partner directly. Mathilde WEIL.

fusionAquisitions.title: Mergers & Acquisitions
fusionAquisitions.intro: Our firm is regularly involved in Mergers & Acquisitions. We support our clients, whether French or foreign companies, in all phases of a transaction, from the legal audit, the preparation and organization of data rooms, the development of strategies specific to each case, the conduct of negotiations through to the completion of the project.
fusionAquisitions.paragraph1: We support our clients, French or foreign companies, in all phases of an operation, from the legal audit, the preparation and organization of data rooms, the development of a strategy specific to each file, the conduct of negotiations until Our perfect command of German and English, in addition to French, allows us to advise our clients and draft all legal documents and contracts in these three languages.The multidisciplinary nature of the Firm allows us to quickly mobilize our various specialists, in order to quickly provide our clients with all the answers to the legal issues that may arise during an operation.Post-operation legal monitoring: Once the Merger operation has been completedSome recent significant examples:Acquisition for a Swiss group, one of the leaders in the sale of perfumes, cosmetic products and luxury products, of a French company specializing in the manufacturing and packaging of such productsAcquisitions for a German group of servicing and maintenance companies in the nuclear fieldAcquisitions for an American group of companies specializing in cloud computingBranch transfer of activity and goodwill in the pharmaceutical field.For any questions relating to subjects of interest in the areas of Mergers Patricia VINCENT.

corporateReglement.title: Corporate & Regulatory
corporateReglement.intro: Our firm is renowned for both its advisory and litigation activities in corporate law matters.
corporateReglement.paragraph1: From their incorporation to their deregistration, our team monitors the legal secretariat of all types of companies, commercial and civil, whether in the context of day-to-day operations (such as holding shareholder meetings, Weil currently manages the legal secretariat of around a hundred companies of all sizes, mainly belonging to international groups.Beyond advisory activity, our Firm assists and represents its clients in all contentious matters relating to corporate law (disputes between shareholders, with directors and corporate officers, liability actions, etc.).For any questions relating to matters relating to company law, you can contact our partner directly. Patricia VINCENT.

contentieux.title: Litigation, mediation and international arbitration
contentieux.intro: Whether it concerns classic litigation or complex procedures with strategic issues before state or arbitral courts, Weil
contentieux.paragraph1: In this role, transparency towards the client is a determining element to avoid any unexpected or unforeseen results. <nl/><square>The first step</square> For us, it always consists of an in-depth analysis of the file in order to propose the strategy financially best suited to the challenges of each file, based on our assessment of the solidity of the file.<nl/><square>With experience</square> of internal and international litigation since 1974, our Firm is equipped with solid reflexes which allow it to appeal to lines of argument using the subtleties of the procedure, sometimes making it possible to put an end to a case without even having to address the merits <nl/><square>In some cases</square> more media, we have experience of using the media as an additional weapon in the management of the procedure.<nl/><square>Finally</square>, we never forget, and at all stages of the procedure, that our clients' business is not to litigate and that litigation always constitutes a source of internal nuisance.

procedureColl.title: Insolvency proceedings
procedureColl.paragraph1: <square>The reactivity</square> and experience in insolvency law are key factors in the success of these operations.<nl/><square>Our Firm</square> is equipped with a <highlight>long experience</highlight> in these areas, allowing us to appreciate the most appropriate options offered by the law for companies in difficulty.

droitCommercial.title: Commercial and Competition Law
droitCommercial.intro: Our team has recognized expertise, thanks to its legal and economic training.
droitCommercial.paragraph1: <bold>In particular, in terms of:</bold><nl/><square>commercial negotiating</square>, pricing transparency and restrictive practices<nl/><square>exclusive distribution</square> and selective distribution<nl/><square>consumer law</square>, advertisement<nl/><square>competition law</square>, cartels, abuse of dominant position and abuse of economic dependence<nl/><square>legal procedures</square> common before civil and criminal courts<nl/><square>DGCCRF investigations</square> and procedures before the Competition Authority and community authorities.<nl/><nl/><bold>Some recent significant missions:</bold><nl/><square>assistance</square> of a leading company in the context of the analysis of anti-competitive practices in the postal market<nl/><square>assistance</square> and representation before the French and European courts of a manufacturer of consumer products<nl/><square>advice</square> for the development of a selective distribution network in the luxury sector, drafting of contracts and General Conditions of Sale<nl/><square>review</square> advertising campaigns and promotional operations for the marketing of electrical hand tools sold in DIY supermarkets<nl/><square>review</square> labeling of garbage bags and food films sold in general supermarkets<nl/><square>exam</square> range discount agreements for several major players in the pharmaceutical sector<nl/><square>elaboration</square> regulatory compliance programs for several players in the automotive sector<nl/><square>assistance</square> and representation of a leading pharmaceutical player in the context of the anti-gift law.

droitNumerique.title: IP/IT, digital, tech and data law
droitNumerique.intro: Our Firm constantly intervenes on behalf of our clients on matters relating to all aspects of intellectual property law and new technologies.
droitNumerique.paragraph1: Here are some recent examples:General industrial property law: we support our clients during company sale or buyout operations, either by preparing the PI/IT part of the dataroom or by carrying out the legal audit during the due diligence phase; Copyright: we represent our clients in infringement proceedings before French courts, e.g. Patent law: we represent our clients during the preparatory phase (planning and execution of counterfeit seizures on French territory) and during counterfeiting and unfair competition trials before the French courts, for example on request. New technologies and IT law: we regularly intervene before courts or specialized arbitration courts for our clients in cases of domain name piracy, e.g. For any questions relating to subjects relating to the areas of intellectual property law and new technologies, please contact our partner directly Bruno WEIL who is responsible for these areas.

droitPenal.title: White collar crime
droitPenal.intro: Our firm has developed recognized expertise in the management of cases related to business criminal law.
droitPenal.paragraph1: We intervene upstream to advise our clients on the strategy to adopt when risky situations arise, for example for any offense linked to economic law or product regulation, or when offenses have been committed by employees or corporate officers. Knowing our clients' activities well, our lawyers are able to assist them effectively, particularly in terms of:Offenses “President fraud” type financial transactionsOffenses in the context of competition law, agreements, abuse of dominant position and abuse of economic dependenceInvestigations of the DGCCRF and common law procedures before the criminal courtsCriminal Law workAbuse of corporate assets, breach of trust, passive and active corruption.For any questions relating to matters relating to business criminal law, you can contact our partner directly. Eric WEIL.

partenaire.teamPresentation: Our firm is made up of four experienced partners with <bold>over 100 years'combined professional experience</bold>. Each of them is fluent in English and German, and has an international legal profile and background. In addition to their specialist areas of expertise, each of our partners has a broad knowledge of business law, covering between them the full range of our clients'activities and needs.<nl/>You will find below an individual presentation of each partner. We also have a team of senior associates and lawyers, all of whom have legal training or international experience.

brunoWeil.intro: Active for twenty-five years as a lawyer for international companies of all sizes, present or active in France, Bruno Weil is your privileged contact within our firm for any question relating to intellectual property, digital, tech and data law, his preferred field. In this capacity, he acts as counsel or advocate before the courts in all types of contentious cases. As counsel he has successfully represented several major US and German listed companies before the French courts, notably in complex patent trademark and copyright infringement cases. A former French correspondent for the publisher KLUWER LAW INTERNATIONAL, he is also a member of several international associations dealing with intellectual property and new technologies, such as the Licensing Executive Society - LES - Germany, GRUR and ITECHLAW. Bruno Weil is also active in other fields, such as corporate restructuring and takeovers. His day-to-day practice also involves all types of business-related litigation. His main aim is to successfully devise the most effective business strategy to ensure that our clients'interests prevail. In addition to French, he is fluent in German and English. An amateur drummer and percussionist, he is the father of three children.

whoWeAre.firmPresentation: Founded in 1974, WEIL & ASSOCIES has rapidly earned a reputation for excellence in corporate law on a global scale. <nl/>At the heart of our mission: cutting-edge legal expertise that fosters innovation and growth for our clients, whether they are multinational companies or SMEs. <nl/>Our versatile team is particularly renowned for its responsiveness and attention to detail, ensuring effective representation before courts and arbitral institutions.
whoWeAre.NOUS SOMMES DEDIES A VOTRE SUCCES: WE ARE DEDICATED TO YOUR SUCCESS
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-dedies-a-votre-succes-descri: Since its establishment in 1974 WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies.<nl/>Our firm is devoted to assist companies, international or small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defence of our clients before courts and arbitral tribunals.
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-internationnaux-description: Business relationships of German and English speaking countries have always been a major part of our activity. Therefore, our firm has lawyers admitted at bars in France, Germany and the USA at the same time.<nl/>Our involvement in the advice to and representation of international clients implies that all lawyers write and speak fluently German, French and English.<nl/>In the course of time, our activity conducted us to broaden our horizon and to represent companies from countries such as Japan, Korea and China.
whoWeAre.plus-loin-plus-intelligent-plus-rapide-d: Even though all lawyers are specialised, we believe in an enrichment of the juristic creativity by a large field of experience in legal advice and defence.
whoWeAre.votre-confiance-nous-honore-description: Our work is based on mutual trust with each and every client, international companies as well as small and medium-sized enterprises.<nl/>Each client’s activity, products and professional environment are carefully taken into consideration as our goal is to provide our client with tailor made solutions which take due account of the client’s specific business interests.<nl/>Thanks to the small size of our firm, we compose a team of dynamic lawyers who are acquainted to respond rapidly and with flexibility to the client’s needs.<nl/>We shall never forget that the essence of our work, be it legal advice or advocacy, is to achieve an economically valuable result for our client.

contact.info-contact: Our offices are located at 26, Avenue de la Grande Armée, just a stone's throw from L'Etoile, in the centre of the business district. You can park your car just a few steps away in the public underground car parks on Avenue Carnot and Porte Maillot. ARGENTINE metro station (line 1) is nearby. Charles de Gaulle - Etoile RER station is a 5-minute walk away.
